page.layout: One scanned page, rotated about ninety degrees, with faint traces of printed lines running across it. No readable text block, heading, margin note or page number can be identified.
page.notes: The scan is nearly blank and very faded. Faint horizontal lines of print are visible in several bands, mostly in the upper and middle part of the page, but no word or letter can be read with any confidence. Dark specks and yellowed stains are visible and are not printed text. Nothing has been transcribed because no reading could be made without guessing.
